faq: Will you edit my live store directly?
No. We work on a duplicate store and show you a preview. When you approve, we apply the changes to your live store or give you the files, as you prefer.
Does it matter which theme I use?
We work with Classic, Hummingbird and many third party themes. If a theme is heavily encrypted or locked, we tell you before we start what is possible.
Can you fix a theme broken by an update?
Yes. We find the template or module override that no longer fits the new version, repair it and check the main pages again.
What do you need from me?
Back office access or a copy of the theme files, a list of changes with screenshots, and a link to any page that looks wrong. We never ask for your password.

desc:
PrestaShop theme edits and template fixes change how your shop looks and behaves without a full redesign. Ecom Swift LLC makes your requested changes in the theme files on a safe copy, checks them and lists every file touched.

## What are PrestaShop theme edits?

PrestaShop theme edits are targeted changes to the files that control your storefront: templates, stylesheets, scripts and theme options. A template decides how a page is assembled, a stylesheet decides how it looks, and a script decides how parts of it move.

Edits range from a color or spacing correction to a new home page section, a reworked header or a repaired mobile menu. They are the right choice when you like your theme overall but need specific things changed.

## Why theme problems are easy to make worse

Theme code is shared by every page of the shop. A small change to a header template shows up everywhere, and a careless style rule can shift a button on the checkout. Editing the live shop directly puts customers in the path of every test and every mistake.

Updates add another risk. If changes are made straight in the parent theme, an update can erase them. The usual cure is a child theme, which keeps your edits separate so that the original can be updated safely.

## How careful theme work improves results

Careful theme work improves results by fixing the points where the storefront gets in the way. A mobile menu that does not open, a product image that overlaps the price, or a checkout step that looks broken on one browser can cost orders without leaving any trace in your reports. Repairing them restores a smooth path.

Tidy edits also help your team. When changes are small, documented and kept in one place, the next developer can understand them, and future updates are less likely to break the shop.

## What good theme edit work includes

- Every edit made on a duplicate store, never first on the live shop.
- Template changes made in Smarty files with clear, minimal code.
- Style changes written so they do not leak into unrelated pages.
- A child theme where your package includes it, to keep edits update-safe.
- Header, menu and footer changes tested on desktop and phone.
- New home blocks or templates built to match your existing design.
- Bug fixes traced to their cause rather than hidden with a patch.
- Checks in several browsers, including mobile browsers.
- A preview link for approval before release.
- A list of changed files and short notes in plain English.

## How we handle your requests

You send us a list of what to change or fix, ideally with screenshots. We copy your store to a safe environment, make the edits there and test them on desktop and mobile. You review the preview and ask for adjustments. Once you approve, we apply the changes to the live shop and confirm everything works.

The Basic package suits a handful of small edits. Standard handles a larger set of edits and fixes, one new template or home block and a header or menu rework, with checks in several browsers. Premium covers the biggest list, sets up a child theme, adds new blocks or templates, styles the checkout pages and ends with a short guide for future edits.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Describe each change with a screenshot or a marked-up example.
- Tell us which pages you care about most.
- Keep a backup of your files and database before work begins.
- Ask for a child theme if you plan more edits later.
- Test the preview on your own phone.

**Avoid:**
- Sending changes piecemeal after work has started.
- Editing the live theme at the same time as we do.
- Installing a second theme update during the project.
- Asking for effects that need heavy scripts on every page.
- Skipping the preview and approving blind.

## Who this is for

This service suits owners who bought a theme and need it to behave a little differently. It suits shops whose theme broke after a PrestaShop or module update. It also suits teams that want a new section on the home page without paying for a full redesign.

## How to get started

Send us your list of changes and your shop address, and tell us which theme you use if you know it. Give us staff or developer access so we can prepare the safe copy, and never send your passwords. We reply with a short checklist, build the changes and send the preview.
